title: Deliver the Adaptive Shopping Capstone
prompt: Build the Level 3 shopping vertical slice with local data, adaptive catalogue and detail, basket flow, animation, themes, accessibility, edge-to-edge, and layered test evidence.
successCriteria: Browse-to-basket works in compact and expanded windows.
TalkBack, keyboard, large text, RTL, and dark theme checks are documented.
Unit, semantic UI, accessibility, and screenshot tests protect distinct contracts.
hints: Write down the ownership and failure contract before choosing library APIs.
Prove one adverse or lifecycle case before improving presentation.
solutionOutline: Model immutable inputs, outputs, events, and failures at the boundary.
Implement the smallest correct path and verify every success criterion.
verification: Run deterministic state or protocol tests.
Inspect the relevant accessibility, lifecycle, concurrency, or network boundary.
